original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 16 Memory Error Information Handle is either the correct specification-defined sentinel for no provided record/no detected error or resolves uniquely to the intended memory-error structure, and that the relationship is correctly reported after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 16, Type 18 and Type 33 records plus SMBIOS version; classify 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF by their distinct defined meanings, resolve any other handle uniquely to the appropriate error record, preserve its fields and compare the state after reboot without creating or clearing errors.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected pre-existing error-record state and reboot plan. No fault injection or clearing is authorized.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 18/Type 33 interpretation
Expected handle state per Type 16 array
Policy for 0xFFFE (no error-information structure) versus 0xFFFF (no error detected)
Expected target record type and persistence if a real handle is present
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS, EDAC and kernel queries only; never inject a memory fault.
Do not clear firmware, BMC, EDAC or kernel error history before or after collection.
Keep 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF meanings distinct; neither is a dangling reference.
Require every non-sentinel handle to resolve exactly once to an allowed error-information structure and preserve all raw fields.
Stop on duplicate/dangling/wrong-type references or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Classify raw sentinel values, resolve non-sentinel handles across complete Type 18/33 data, correlate read-only error context and compare pre/post reboot state.
Do not create errors, erase history, alter ECC policy or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected sentinel/record state and version-specific target policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess any real error content and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The handle text is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot preserve its raw value, array identity, sentinel meaning or target-record integrity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16/18/33 output; for each array report the raw handle, sentinel classification or unique target handle/type, all linked error fields and any resolution defect.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The handle scope, Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is rejected because it destroys the state this cross-reference describes.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse every Type 16 raw handle, distinguish both defined sentinels, otherwise resolve a unique matching Type 18/33 node under the applicable version policy, and compare the preserved graph after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS implementations exposing Type 16 and optional memory-error information records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser, kernel and EDAC versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Memory Error Information Handle sentinel semantics and Type 18/33 handle/type definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw sentinel differentiation and referential-integrity validation instead of accepting a displayed handle string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects conflated sentinel meanings, dangling/duplicate/wrong-type handles and unexpected error-record mutation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected error-record state and version-aware target policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A valid sentinel or record link does not exercise ECC or prove that future hardware errors will be detected and logged.

project_override_considerations: A project may expect no error structure, no detected error, or an approved pre-existing record, but must state which distinct handle state applies; it cannot require fault injection merely to populate this metadata row.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, SMBIOS version and expected sentinel/record policy
Per-array raw handle, exact sentinel interpretation or unique target resolution and linked error fields
Read-only EDAC/kernel context and explicit confirmation that no error was injected or history cleared
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot graph/state comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The handle field has defined sentinel and reference semantics; expected live state is a project input, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sentinel classification and referential-integrity checking are fully automatable without fault injection.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw-value preservation, distinct sentinel semantics and unique Type 18/33 resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its no-injection and complete-record controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates pre-existing diagnostic-state interpretation and engineer verdict from automated graph validation.

review_improvement: Prevents a special sentinel from being mislabeled as broken and prevents a syntactically valid non-sentinel from passing when its target is absent or wrong-type.
independent_technical_reasoning: This field is a 16-bit discriminated reference: its two reserved values and ordinary handle graph can be exhaustively evaluated from read-only structured data.
